body:
THE REAL SIZE AND THE ORDER (app/lib read and measured 6 Nov 2026, main 66efba9). The task text (the homelab portal and the second import screen) understates it.

WHAT IS LEFT OVER, in lines: data/requests 778 + features/requests 958 (the homelab request portal, `HomelabPortalClient`), data/fetch 783 (the old "instant play service" client and its import models), the duplicate import screens (features/import/import_screen.dart 685, features/settings/import_screen.dart 649), and the dead files of register B-25 (app/audio_output.dart and features/player/speed_sheet.dart are imported by NOTHING; `PlaceholderSettingsScreen`, settings_screens.dart:487). Twelve files OUTSIDE those folders import them: app/alerts_wiring.dart, app/app.dart, domain/import_file.dart, features/import/{encore_import_screen, import_card, import_providers, import_screen, imported_playlist_screen}.dart, features/instant/{instant_controller, instant_play}.dart, features/settings/{import_screen, your_server_screen}.dart. Delete from the outside in, or the build breaks.

THE ONE PATH THAT RUNS ON AN ENCORE PHONE TODAY (do this first): app/background_sync.dart:85-97 runs `AlertsService` in the background job with a phone-side `DeezerClient()` (ADR-R38, goes with P2-15) AND `readPortalImports(... fallbackPassword: password)` (app/alerts_wiring.dart:25-65). That reader returns early when no portal address was ever saved (alerts_wiring.dart:33-34), so a fresh install sends nothing; but a phone that saved one while it was in the old mode would send the MUSIC-SERVER login to that address as the portal's login (line 40: "No password of its own: the service takes the music server's login"). Remove the fallback at once, then the reader, then the portal.

WIRING THAT STARTS LEGACY CODE ON EVERY LAUNCH (app/app.dart): imports 17-25; `ref.watch(activityPublisherProvider)` (69, the old people service), `jamSpeakerProvider` and the Jam message listener (90-97, a hub the product does not run: B-20), `importsProvider` (113), the shared-text listener that opens the OLD import page `/settings/import` (122-160), `requestArrivalsProvider` (162-172). Each is a provider that builds an object at start-up for a feature the Encore server does not have.

DO NOT widen the scope silently. The plain-music-server MODE (data/people 946 + features/people 1007, `EncoreUpgrade`, the old-way sync branches in sync_engine.dart, `syncTheOldWay`) is B-16's second half; its end is a separate decision (P2-11 is Later). Say in the PR which half this item removes.

CHECKS: the outside-host ratchet baseline in app/test/architecture_test.dart drops (Deezer stays 1 until P2-12 lands); test/data/requests/ and test/data/fetch/ go with their code; run `grep -rn "requests/\|data/fetch" app/lib` to 0 before the last commit; `docs/17`/`31` rows that name the portal (31 O-9, 33 PB-4) change in the same PR. The Notifications page still says "Imports and requests" (B-54 part 3) until this lands.
